invariants.rationale: The method expects a specific instant time to perform the bulk insert, so instantTime should typically not be null.
The list of records to insert should not be null; a null value would likely result in failure.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is required for the operation to execute in the engine.
The size of records should be non-negative if the list is empty or otherwise.
Option objects are typically not null, though they can represent absence inside the object.
